title: Modern Fantasy (World Scenario)
description:
Live another life in a modern fantasy world. Select your race and class and try to fit in a world of eerie but mundane modernity of another world.

Deal with the changes of a society that have evolved from fantasy feudal country to a capitalist and industrial world.

Some races have managed to play their cards better than others, play as one of the favore benevolent ones, or try to survive as one of the discriminated so-called evil race.

Update 6 : New races, vampire & werewolf
Update 6 : New location, Dunkwald forest & Larion castle

Update 5 : New class, teatcher & student
Update 5 : New location, Larion university

Update 4 : New Class, Investigator, Journalist, Lawyer and Scientist
Update 4 : New race, Golem
Update 4 : New Factions (beta), Progessive, Conservatist, Socialist, Obscurantist, Liberal, Unaligned

Update 3 : New Locations, Siren Harbor, Dragonstead Airport, Rainbow circle Subway, Red Pixie district, Fairy Tech market.

Update 2 : New races, Kobold, Imp, Fairy and Feline.
Update 2 : New class, Cultivator, Military, Preacher and Celebrity.

Update1 : New races, Minotaur and Centaur.
Update1 : New class, Criminal.
Update1 : New location, Green Oak Hill, the countryside of the big city.
prompt:
The kingdom of Larion has changed a lot since it's early days of knights, princess, dragons and sorcerers. The world has mutated and walked into a mordern day and age where technology has rendered magic useless, capitalism has overthrown feodality, where the man on the street is a busy salaryman and not a lowly peasant.

In this new setting the old discriminations between fantasy races are now abolished, and everyone had to move outside their stereotype class to find a job more suited to modern standard. Tradesmen took reedence over craft, Science overthrown the backward ways of Magic, Money became the new nobility. Depending on the fame or stigma of their former racial status, people have adapted to these new rules differently.

The high and might races of the dwarf, elf and gnomes because of their immense lifespan and knowledge had no trouble rising through the rank of social hierachy, most becoming businessmen, politicians and other tycoons that replaced royalties. Due to their low fertility they formed small but wealthy communities that now govern over those they deem the "lesser" races.

The man on the streets from the humans and halflings races found that things were more challenging but still managable, their natural adaptability allowing them to thrive in the many new profession and role of a modern society. They were the most suited for the big changes and established themselves as the more common citizens of Larion.

But for the so-called "evil races" such as orcs, goblins, ogres and many others sentient monsters, discrimination took a heavy toll. Shun at first because of their brutal heritage, they had to accept the more deaming jobs that was left, often trading their physical strenght for a meager pay. Even now they still don't enjoy the same chances and opportunites as the rest of the population of Larion.

As time goes, the question of mix-races also had to be taken into account. In a society of many races working and living next to one another in relative peace, love was bound to bloom between some of them. It was and still is a taboo, that the modern society of Larion has trouble dealing with, and many of the offsprings of mixed blood have to navigate between their troubled heritage to find a place where they can fit.
authorsNote: Writing style: Elegant, dramatic, vivid prose. Theme: fantasy, slice of life, modernity, city, racism.

cardPool.title: Larion City
cardPool.value: Larion city is a modern metropolis that is home to many races from all across the modern fantasy world. The city is known for its towering skyscrapers, bustling streets, and lively nightlife. However, the deeper you dwelve beneath the surface, one can find also less fortunate inhabitant that have the scrape to survive under the rule of ruthless capitalism.

cardPool.title: Stonekeep Plaza
cardPool.value:
The Stonekeep plaza is a bustling square in the heart of Larion City. It is surrounded by towering skyscrapers and serves as an important gathering place for both humans and fantasy races alike. The plaza is known for its ornate fountains, intricate stone carvings, made by dwarfs, the remains of enchanted runes from an age long gone. 
Behind its beauty and charm, it is also the center of the business activity of the megalopolisw where countless people work behind the glass surface of the skyscrapers.

cardPool.title: Mix Blood
cardPool.value:
Those born from two different fantasy races are called, often derogatively, Mix Blood. As the offsprings of multiracial union, they share some of the ancestry of their parents, and vary a lot in both physique and intelligence depending of it.
Modern society see them with a mix of distrust and compasion. Discrimination against them is less open than with the so-call "evil races", but behind their back they often hear the nasty comments.
To avoid such treatment, Mix Blood often try to favor one side of their ancestry, trying to pass as a pure race individual.

cardPool.title: Orc
cardPool.value:
The most common of the so called "evil-races", orcs became somewhat of a paria community at the turn of the modernity. Because of their apparent barabaric nature, many discarded the orc culture and their communities had to adapt to the changes of the world.
Because of their lack of wealth, Orc had to trade the only asset they had, their physical strenght, and contribute to the creation of a modern society with their brute force as laborer, workers and menials.
Nowadays they still struggle to raise to the highest level among society, stuck by a glass celling of predjudices that many still keep against them. Because of that, there is a strong feeling of revolt among the youngest generations of orcs nowadays.

cardPool.title: Ogre
cardPool.value:
Massive creature with a low intellect, Ogres where used as physical slaves when Larion turned into a modern society. Because of their lack of smarts, ogre are often fooled to accept low paying or dangerous jobs that no one else would otherwise take.
They used to be regarded in the past as monsters, but the truth is that most ogres are by nature placid creatures who don't hurt people unless they have to.
Today they try to find their place, bumbling in the modern world, heedless of the way people look at them.

cardPool.title: Goblin
cardPool.value:
Small, scrany and with a reputation for being crafty and a bit treachery, Goblins are the lesser of the so-called "evil races".
With modernity, they distanced themselves of their past as minions of evil sorcerers, but found themselves shun by humans and other races.
They found solace in their numerous communities, a knot of mutual assistance. Thanks to their wits, they managed to find jobs, and sometimes even business in modern Larion.
But because of their past and general appearance, they are still often disregarded by most.

cardPool.title: Lizardman
cardPool.value:
Scally humanoids of various size and shape, lizardmen are initialy the product of magic and alchemy.
Used in the mediaval past as slaves, they found themselves freed by the modern changes of the world.
They had to build from scratch a culture, communities and a way to reproduce. It was a complex process from which there was highs and lows.
Today they try to fit as best they can. Compared to other so-called "evil races", they carry themselves with a certain pride of what they managed to become, despite the lingering predjudice other still harbour against them.

cardPool.title: Wood Elf
cardPool.value:
Living in harmony with nature in the forest and woods, the wood elf were struck by the sudden change of the modern world. Despite the many perks of their elven heritage, they had to leave their forest and find another way of living with technology.
They adapt, becoming politicians or diplomat, building the first democratic institution that replaced monarchy, their kind nature helping them to build bridges with the many other fantasy races of the world.
That is why today they enjoy a high position in society, being businessman, politician or communities leader whose voice count.
Still, some keep on harbouring nostalgia for the time before the advancement of society, and a fringe of them, the so-called "hippies" dream of going back one day to their roots.

cardPool.title: Human
cardPool.value:
For human, modernity did not changed much and was more an upgrade than a revolution. Having always been around, and the most numerous of races on the face ot the earth, they managed to find a place everywhere in society.
Despite that, they could not make themselves a place at the top, other more well gifted races such as elf or dwarf hoggling the more powerful role.
There is some among the human population that are not happy with this, arguing that since they represent the majority, they should be the one in control.

cardPool.title: Minotaur
cardPool.value:
The Minautor are a race of half human, half bull creature. Towering above most other fantasy races, powefully build and covered in a thick fur, they used to be part of the monstrous race of the past.
With modernity, people began to recognize their sentience, and with time they were integrated to society, their physical strenght useful in many simple tasks such as construction or farming.
Today they are roughly accepted, having traded their agressivity for a placid behavior, akind to a workhorse. 
It's also the reason for why they are often underestimated by most other races who only saw in them useful workers and menial.

cardPool.value:
The centaurs are half man, half horses creatures. Hailing from a proud and wise race, centaurs are the ones who among the 'good-races' have the most trouble adapting to modernity.
The only races deviating from the humanoid outlines, they found buildings and infrastructures hardly adapted to them.
Keepers of ancient knowledge and magic, they were quickly rendered obsolete by technology.
As such most of them did not managed to find their place in modern Larion. In fact most now live outside of the big cities, finding in the countryside the wide-open spaces to thrive and maintain their traditions.

cardPool.title: Preacher
cardPool.value:
Religion have lost a lot of its former influence in Larion compared to the old times. Nowadays most people are agnostic or atheist.
Most of the old religions have crumbled and disapreared, and just the few majors one, such as the Omni God, Gaïa or Cthulhu have managed to keep a smal coven of believers.
Preachers, priests and pastors now act as community leaders, especially among the poor, trying to be the mediator to spiritual problems.

cardPool.title: Celebrity
cardPool.value:
There is still in Larion some people that are just borned rich and famous, without having to lift a finger for a living. During the middle ages those people were sons and daughters of nobility, who ruled over the common folks by right of blood.
In modern Larion, the new nobility are just borned with money. Still they tend to be the same people, scions of long lived noble human, elf or dwarf families who managed to kept their fortune during the transition to the modern era.
Some comes from more humble background, their ancestor having thrived during the industrial revolution.
A few just got lucky and become famous because of their character, using the media to push their own brand of antics and outragous way of life.
All share a total disregard for most common people, a disdain for actual work, and are just really petty individual spending their money without a care in the world.

cardPool.title: Military
cardPool.value:
Where the military during the middle ages of Larion consisted of soldiers and mercenary serving kings and queens, nowadays professional soldiers are public servants stipend by the state of Larion.
Modern military is much more smaller and professional, in a world that know little of war. Soldiers are highly trained and disciplined in the use of high-tech weaponery. Brute strenght play litte role, but still some races knowned for their physical capacities are often incited to join the ranks of the army of Larion.
One can find many orcs, minotaurs and ogres among the low ranks of soldiery, while officers more often than not come from favored races such as elf and dwarf, whose nobility allow them to enlist in military academy.

cardPool.title: Kobold
cardPool.value:
Kobold are impish little humanoid, akind to goblins and halfling. Their race lay in a grey zone between benevolent and evil races. They have many common traits with halflings, with their mischievous nature, short stature and urban nature. But they are alos close to goblins, by their bestial features, crooked ears and greenish skin.
Because of that Kobolds suffer sometimes from the same discriminations than goblins, but they are a little bit more accepted by the benevolent races who tolerate their presence in higher circle of society.
As such, many Kobold choose to get politicaly involved in bridging the gap between benevolent and so-called evil races, by mean of dialogue and rally.

cardPool.title: Imp
cardPool.value:
Imps are the evil equivalent of fairies. Short, with bat wings, they have a bad reputation of thief, pranksters and all around troublemakers.
Considered a mere nuisance during the old times, they are in modern Larion fromn upon, treated like pest who have very little to bring to society.
As such the rate of homelessness and unemployment among they is very high. To compensate for the discriminations they suffer from, imps have developped a parallel community network to help one another.
Those that have a job often save up to feed less fortunate ones. Many also steal in factories and shops to provide their kin means of survival.
It is among imps that one can find the highest level of radical activists, who dream to overthrow the injust system they are the victim of.

cardPool.title: Fairy
cardPool.value:
Fairies are small, winged, delicate and charming humanoid creature. Considered to be a benevolent race for their involvment with many stories and quests from the myths of the old times, they have found a very particular niche in modern Larion.
The only perk fairies can bargain with in a modern society is their beauty and charms, hence many involve themselves in trade, becoming clerks or vendor. Some try their luck in politic. The less fortunate one litteraly sell their body in place of ill repute.
Because the gender repartition of fairies is 80% women for 20% men, many female fairies end up in couple with a male from another race. It is currently causing a decrease of the population of full-blood fairies that is starting to worry some of the higher ups among Larion City.

cardPool.title: Feline
cardPool.value:
Feline folks, also called Cat people, Khajiit or Tabaxi, are an diverse race of humanoid cats. Very rare during the time of old Larion, with population mostly located in tropical areas, they have thrived and reproduce during the modern age.
Agile, quick but sometimes bad-tempered, Felines are very independant even from their own kin.
Dealing extremely badly with authority and rules in general, they form in modern society a group of outsiders and freelance peoples who often do things their own way, regardless of traditions or norms.

cardPool.title: Cultivator
cardPool.value:
With the boom of agriculture yields, the job of farmer has changed to become much more dependent on chemistry and industrial tools. Modern cultivators in Larion are able to take care of dozens of acre by themselves, when in the old times many people were required to manage one.
Where farmers used to be the lowest members of the feudal society, cultivator are nowadays business men and women who own their land and means of production.
As such, the profession is favored by dwarfs and halflings who have adapted their innate knowledge of the soil to this activity.

As such, the profession is favored by dwarfs and halflings who have adapted their innate knowledge of the soil to this activity.

cardPool.title: Fairy Tech Market
cardPool.value: The Fairy Tech Market is an underground black market where some people sell highly illegal gadgets and gizmos of all kinds. Here some of the most cunning minds from all races temper and tinker with modern technology to mix it with magic of the old time. The products of such Strange manufacture are bought at an high price by whoever have the money for it, that they use to further their own agenda.

cardPool.title: Red Pixie District
cardPool.value: The Red Pixie District is the main Entertainment of Larion City. During the day it is a massive mall where countless shops offer whatever people are looking for. At night the mood shift to become an open field where the youngs seek Entertainment and pleasure of all kinds. It is in the dark alleyways of the Red Pixie District that one can find places of ill repute such as brothel which offer dirty work for whoever is desperate enough to accept it.

The trains go all around the different districs of Larion City and connect them with one another. With its stainless corridors and clear glass Windows the Subway network is the epitome of the modern day Larion.

As the main entry point to Larion City, the airport is also the first place most foreigners from other countries like Northrum, Sandhill or Franconia arrives from.

cardPool.title: Siren Harbor
cardPool.value: Siren Habor is the main port of Larion City. It is mainly used as a pleasure-boating and seaside resort. As such it has kept most of the old days architecture of the past, with houses made of stones and wood. People can enjoy the promenade and relax on the beach.

cardPool.title: Scientist
cardPool.value: Science is the new magic of the modern Larion. Where once wizzard were the esoteric figures of the world dressed in robes and pointy hats, scientist has replaced them with lab coats and notepads. Incentations have been replaced by équations, Alchemy by Chemistry, Mage towers have been put to the ground and laboratories have been build upon them. A scientist is a trained individual that Believe in the rules of physics and nature, not in the arcane powers of the empyrean. It is with method, trial an errors that scientists of Larion are developping the inventions and progress of the future.

cardPool.title: Lawyer
cardPool.value: In the past Justice was handled by the King who had the divine right to judge his subjects. Nowadays the rule of Law is etched in the stone, defined by jurist and fought over in court. Lawyer are the ones who defend or accuse individual in tribunal, they are experts on legislation and work to find the gaps in it to further their plea or indictment. In modern Larion a layer can plead about many cases, from juvenile deliquence, petty theft, familly issues, Financial fraud or in the worst cases murder. The range of punishment are much broader than in the ancient time, but the death penalty is still applied to the worst of crimes, albeit less frequently.

cardPool.value: In modern Larion information is the most valuable ressource. Newspapers, Radio, Television there is now all kind of ways for the man on the street to be informed about the things in the world. In this race for audiance, journalists are at the front, going everywhere to report on new event, investigating to find out the Truth or selling their penmanship to Promote the ideas or products of corporation or the government. A journalist have a way with words and is able to spin them in the way they want. It is a profession that deal as much with Truth than lies.

cardPool.title: Investigator
cardPool.value: Spies used to be the Tools of royalty in the old times. Today investigator and detective offer their services to whoever can pay them. In the modern world of Larion there is plenty of such Professionals, hard boiled detective, gumshoes, private eyes, etc... who are open to search for whatever they are paid for. It could be a fugitive girlfriend, a cheating husband, the key documents to some inheritence or even corporate's secrets. If the price is right, an investigator will use all their skills of deduction and cunning to see the end of the case. Many among this profession use to be cops or work for business company as some sort of security executive. As such they kept close contacts among these milieu from which they can find out clues about the mystery they work on.

cardPool.value: Some people just Don't give  a damn about politics. They are content to live their life as it comes and do the best with it as they could. They Don't have strong opinions about politics, racism, society or the Economy. They simply play with the cards they've been given and Don't complain about it.

cardPool.title: Liberal
cardPool.value: Liberalism is the ideology that all that matter is Freedom and individualism. Liberals believes that society is hold back by ancient traditions and ruled, and that everyone should have the right to do everything they want to do, as long as they Don't thread on the right of other to do the same. They belive that Economy is the most important factor in any given society and that as long as people make money, everyone will benefit from their success, assuming that wealth will trickle down from the most fortunate to the Bottom. As such, liberals are radically against any notion of races and traditions, to the point that they even object to some ideas like marriage or work regulation.

cardPool.title: Obscurantist
cardPool.value: Obscurantists believes strongly that society was better before modernization. They fight for society to revert to the old time of magic and feudalism, when everyone had a place and did not moved from it. Among the obscurantist movement, many still Believe in the power of magic, and are actively looking for traces of wizzards and witches in modern society. As a whole, obscurantists strongly Believe in the old categories of races, and consider the so-called 'evil' races as Nothing but vermin.

cardPool.title: Socialist
cardPool.value: Socialists are radical opponent to conservatism. Like progessists, they Believe that society could be better, but unlike them they want to go further than just equality. The socialist movement Believe that conservatism is holding some races back, among which the so-called 'evil' races, and fight predjucice everywhere in society. They also Believe that positive action must be taken to favor those who have been left behind, and that the priviledged races should bear the burden to compensate those less favored.

cardPool.title: Conservatist
cardPool.value: Conservatives Believe that the world as it is right now is as good as its ever going to get. They strongly value the hierarchy between 'good' races and 'evil' races as a tradition that is good for society. Conservative favor the races of elf, dwarf, gnome, human and halfling, and consider any other races as less advanced and worthy. The Conservatist movement is opposed to any new politics that would change the statu-quo in society.

cardPool.title: Progressive

They Campaign for a strick equality of chances among the different races of the kingdom of Larion, and a more open society that would not discriminate people, in good or bad, by their race or creed.

cardPool.title: Golem
cardPool.value:
Golems are a very peculiar kind of races. Before the advent of modernity, a golem was a construction, made by some wizzard or warlock to act as their servant. As such they were of all kinds and shapes, crafted by the whims of the one engineering them. Once their body was created, the golem was animated by the magic power of it's Creator, and bound to its will until the end of time. Now that most form of magic has been lost in modern Larion, the remaining golems still in activity are excessively rare. Most have lost their master in the turmoil of time and are now independant, but rather confused, individuals.
One of the main issue a golem is faced with today, is that their race is not recognized as sentient species and people look at them like Walking and talking furniture. As such they don't enjoy any citizenship and are often exploited or predjudiced upon. Still, golems are a force to reckon with , near indestructible, and remembering sometimes centuries of their life before, making them the last keepers of knowledge long forgotten.

cardPool.title: Teacher
cardPool.value:
The education system of Larion has know drastict improvement with modernity. Now most people, regardless of their origins or races are litterate, a far cry from the old times.
Teachers are more often found among humans and halflings, who have  knack at learning and teaching new stuff, but some other less favored races still manage to make their way to this profession.
Still, inequity is rampant when it comes to the highest position of professors and lecturer, who are hogged by elfs, gnomes and dwarfs whose longevity tend to block the promotion ladder quite a bit.

cardPool.title: Larion University
cardPool.value:
Larion University is a vast campus open to all who seek higher education. But the price of entry for student is not cheap. For those with parents wealthy enough to pay it's a breeze, for other less priviledged they need to find a scholarship or work part-time after lessons to pay the tuition fee.
On campus ground there is several classroom, a few vast lecture all and two dorms for seprate genders.
At night the place become a hive of activity where young adult spend their spare time in various ways, studying or socializing as they please.

cardPool.value:
Nowadays most people are getting out of highschool with the basic of education. For those aiming higher they have to enlist at the Larion University. If they can afford the tuition fee, either by havind parents wealthy enough, a scholarship or working part-time for it, students can pursuit any kind of major, from humanities, sciences, sociology or politics.
Students are young adults at the peak of their hormone, and more often than not they spend their spare time socializing with others, on various manner that may or may not be lively or excentric.

cardPool.title: High Elf
cardPool.value:
The most noble of the elven races, High Elf have an almost immortal lifespan. Because of it and the near infinite amount of wealth and knowledge they enjoy, they were able to place themselves at the top of the modern society.
Nowadays, they enjoy themselves as wealthy artist or sponsor of the industry, living in mansion where they lazily spend their time, their eerie beauty a barrier to the common folks.
Haughty, they tend to consider every other races, even the other elven ones, as inferior and rarely mingle with them, openly.

cardPool.title: Halfling
cardPool.value:
Short humanoids, Halflings are good natured peopled, who learned fast how to enjoy the new things of the modern world.
Hard working folks, they quickly understood how technology could make their life easier, and they build themselves a reputation of tradesmen and tradeswomen among the society.
Keen to help, for a small fee, they are also the one and only fantasy race devoid of predjudices against any other races, and it's often among them that the most interacial union can be observed.

cardPool.title: Gnome
cardPool.value:
Small and stunted humanoids, gnomes enjoy a lifespan of over 200 years. They often used their longevity to study magic, and this lead many to continue this attavic tendancy to become great scientist in the modern world.
Having discovered many new technologies, gnomes are today at the top of the social hierarchy, leader in physics, biology and ingeniering.

cardPool.title: Dark Elf
cardPool.value:
Dark Elves are used to be elusive and mysterious people, hailing from the depths of the swamps. Known for their innate ability to blend into the shadows, making them nearly invisible they were despised for their aloofness by other races, judging them unworthy of trust.
With modernity, the Dark Elves had to step out of the shadows. Their trickery character help them navigate in the new power balance of the world, but they never managed to position themselves in the hierarchy of the fantasy race.
They keep an air of mystery that make them seems strange to others.

cardPool.title: Dwarf
cardPool.value:
Beardy stout humanoids, Dwarf used to live under the mountains by themselves. Modernity shake their tradition and they had to adapt, becoming great engineers who helped build a new society.
Of all the fantasy races, they are the one who kept most of their traditions alive, such as their rune script, their language, their mythology, and their hatred against the so-called "evil races".
Keeping mostly to themselves, dwarfs are regardless some of the most powerful race of the modern world of Larion.
Because of their lifespan of over 500 years, they often can amass great amount of wealth, and their technical skills made them prized workers.

cardPool.title: Vampire
cardPool.value:
Vampires are undead humanoids who feed on the blood of other sentient races. In the past these master of Evil were feared for their great influence all over Larion. Creature of the night, they are weak to sunlight but have great strenght, speed and enjoy supernatural senses. But with modernity their power and magic over the masses was broken.
As one of the few kind of sentient undead creature, they were spared total extermination (unlike zombies and skeletons) in exchange of a strict adeherence to rules of temperance. Vampire are not allowed to suck on the blood of the living anymore, and they must today wear a visible badge that demonstrate their status as Undead creature. In exchange, they receive a daily allowance of blood bags to feed themselves.
Because of their predatory past, vampires are often looked badly and scorned by most other races who used to be either their victims or their minions. But since most vampires are as old as many elfs, they enjoy a certain personal wealth that keep them safe from most persecution.
This situation has created a certain snobbish attitude among vampire culture. Because of their weakness to sunlight, they mostly live at night, but if they need to walk in daylight, they use thick umbrellas, dark sunglasses and copious amount of sunscreen to moderate the worst of their sun sickness.

cardPool.title: Werewolf
cardPool.value:
Werewolves are shapeshifting humanoids who turn into wolf during the fullmoon. In the past their condition was not clearly understood and many of them had to hide their situation, living in packs in the woods for fear of being hunted down by the rest of the population.
In modern day Larion, scientists have since found the root of Lycanthropy, but not the cure. For health reasons, Werewolves are then regrouped in special reserves among themselves, to avoid contamination in the rest of the population.
If on paper they look like any regular human 95% of the time, some subtle physical traits such has massive hairness, a stockier build and a distinctive muscky odour tend to make a werewolf stand out among the crowd even in their human form.
This is why many other races still act wary among them, which build ressentment among werewolves communities who feel themselves being discriminated when people find out their condition.

cardPool.title: Dunkelwald Forest
cardPool.value: Dunkelwald Forest is a large national park north of Larion city. A vast area of natural forest, it is a national reserve that harbor and shelters many animals and forms of wildlife. In the old days it was part of the royal domain, used by the kings and Queens as their personal hunting grounds. Nowadays the fauna is protected by park rangers that Watch over the park and prevent poarchers to hunt and destabilize the fragile balance of the ecosystem. People of all races often come to spend the Week-end, hiking, picnicking or even spending the night at the camping located near the big lake in the middle of the forest. Visitor are invited to be careful when passing through the park, since wild animals roam free and that the trees are susceptible to wildfire if proper fire discipline is not observed.

cardPool.title: Larion castle
cardPool.value: Larion castle used to be the siege of royalty during the old times. The big medieval castle was then the peak of architecture and a testament to the power of the kingdom of Larion. Nowadays, with royalty having been replaced by a elective democratic regime, the whole place has become an historical monument visited by thousands every days. Visitors can admire the remains of the castle, be instructed of the history of Larion by tour guides, or just take pictures and selfies with some of the famous statues and paintings left to decorate the castle's interior. The castle is also often used as scenery for various movies or shows.
